objective: Implement and optimize gated residual combination from scratch using self-authored CUDA C++ on Alibaba PPU ZW-M890P. Triton, CuteDSL, and prebuilt compute operators are not permitted.

evaluation.correctness_requirement: Preserve the reference BF16 multiplication rounding followed by BF16 addition, all outputs, and input immutability; elementwise abs(candidate-reference) <= 0.01 + 0.05 * abs(reference).
evaluation.performance_requirement: Minimize the equal-weight geometric mean latency across all 24 Valid cases; no Test holdout.

operator_contract.layout: Inputs are contiguous logical tensors but residual and mix_aux can be views with nonzero storage offsets. Return a new output; do not mutate any input.
operator_contract.hardware: PPU ZW-M890P exposes CUDA-compatible PyTorch. Query Runtime env/dev for the actual compiler/toolchain. No managed clock locking.

invariants: All inputs and outputs are BF16
Preserve input data and handle nonzero tensor storage offsets

coverage_regimes.name: views
coverage_regimes.requirement: nonzero storage offset in residual and mix_aux
